artboards.title: T1 · Tracker: table in canvas + tracker conversation
T3 · Status change: inline pill, or by chat
T4 · Pick Interview, it asks when, in the same popover

annotations.text:
Flow 4, the Tracker. Locked 19 Aug 2026 with Wasim (T1).

'Tracker table' in the sidebar opens the table in the canvas; the conversation column is the tracker's own chat. One count per status, no checkboxes, rows are company + role, match, an inline status pill and a NEXT column that says what to do. Clicking a row opens that application's conversation.

T1: the chat opens with the state of play (one interview, two overdue follow-ups, a kit not sent) and chips that do the work: draft the overdue follow-up, prep for the interview, hide rejected. In this width the table drops the Saved date column so company and role read fully (the date shows on hover and in the row's conversation).

T3: two ways to change a status. Inline: click the pill, pick from Drafted / Applied / Follow-up sent / Interview / Offer / Rejected. By chat: 'Zapier moved to interview, Tuesday 26th at 10' updates the row, sets NEXT and offers a prep note. Same six statuses everywhere, including the sidebar pills.

T4: the date belongs to the status change. Picking Interview (or Follow-up sent, Offer) turns the same popover into step two: quick chips (Tomorrow, Thu 21, Fri 22, Pick a date), a time field, Save. Skipping the date is allowed. The NEXT cell stays clickable afterwards to edit it. Status pill = what, NEXT = when.
